POST /api/Auth/register

Body:

{
  "username": "admin",
  "email": "admin@gmail.com",
  "password": "123456",
  "role": "Admin"
}

  "username": "instructor1",

18. Login
POST /api/Auth/login

مثلاً:

{
  "username": "admin",
  "password": "123456"
}

ستحصلين على:

{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "username": "admin",
  "role": "Admin"
}


Token : eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1_O3eL_5Sc4xsoeQmpi9C57XstQgP9WSQCw9xJJSisg
